decks.notes: The key strategy of this deck is to utilize the synergy between Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief to create a powerful combo that generates massive amounts of tokens and buffs them with counters. By ramping up with Eldrazi Temple and utilizing cards like Malevolent Rumble and Sowing Mycospawn, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures. Additional control elements like Dismember and Vexing Bauble help to disrupt opponents' strategies while setting up for a game-winning play with Emrakul, the Promised End.

The deck focuses on consistently tutoring creatures from the deck using Green Sun's Zenith and Agatha's Soul Cauldron, utilizing Leyline of Abundance to ramp up mana production. The combo pieces include Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana, which can be used to either win the game with Walking Ballista or Craterhoof Behemoth. The toolbox aspect of the deck allows for versatility in different matchups, with cards like Eternal Witness and Fiend Artisan providing recursion and tutoring options. Overall, the deck aims to assemble powerful creature combos and overwhelm opponents with a variety of threats.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and other ramp spells to power out massive Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes control elements such as Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Kozilek's Command to disrupt opponent's strategies. Disciple of Freyalise and Fight Rigging help to generate additional mana and provide support for the Eldrazi creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while keeping them in check with control spells.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes powerful Eldrazi creatures and planeswalkers like Ugin, Karn, and Emrakul to control the game and overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Trinisphere, Glaring Fleshraker, and Thought-Knot Seer disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Expedition Map helps find the necessary lands. Chalice of the Void and All Is Dust provide additional board control, making it difficult for the opponent to execute their game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By using a combination of powerful creatures like Nishoba Brawler and Scion of Draco, along with spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and control the board. Leyline of the Guildpact and Stubborn Denial help protect your creatures and spells, while Tribal Flames provides additional reach to finish off the opponent. Overall, this deck focuses on fast, impactful plays to quickly dismantle the opponent's defenses and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of control spells and creature removal to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage. By playing powerful control cards like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize, along with targeted removal like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict, the deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from developing their own threats. Additionally, the inclusion of card draw and recursion spells like Consign to Memory and Drown in the Loch helps ensure that the player can stay ahead in resources throughout the game.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quick and efficient ways to deal damage to the opponent. It includes high-impact spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to target creatures or the opponent directly. The deck also utilizes cheap, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to pressure the opponent early on. Additionally, it includes cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Cori-Steel Cutter to maintain board presence and control. The mana base supports the aggressive strategy with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands for consistency.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to rapidly deploy threats and apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. The deck focuses on playing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to clear the way for attacks. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Preordain and Mishra's Bauble to help maintain card advantage and find key pieces. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent access to the right colors of mana.

The deck focuses on quickly controlling the board by utilizing aggressive creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk, while also using Blink effects such as Solitude and Flickerwisp to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Thoughtseize and Prismatic Ending help remove threats on the opponent's side, while Quantum Riddler and Witch Enchanter provide card advantage and disruption. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive effects, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This UR Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, backed up by efficient removal spells such as Lava Dart and Lightning Bolt. The deck also utilizes card advantage and card selection tools like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain a steady stream of threats. By applying pressure early and efficiently managing resources, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck revolves around creating a powerful combo with Broodscale Bloodchief, utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate a strong board presence. The deck also includes key pieces like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command for additional support. With access to powerful lands like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to control the game with efficient removal and threats while building towards its combo finish. The inclusion of cards like Gemstone Caverns and Vexing Bauble help to accelerate the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and utilizing artifacts to create a fast and aggressive board state. By leveraging cards like Urza's Saga, Mox Opal, and Engineered Explosives, the deck can generate powerful threats early in the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tormod's Crypt provide additional utility and graveyard interaction. The inclusion of cards like Metallic Rebuke and Pithing Needle offer disruption and control elements to protect the deck's key pieces. The main goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a consistent stream of threats and disruption.

The deck focuses on using cards like Hydroelectric Specimen and Goblin Charbelcher to create a powerful combo without relying on lands. With ways to disrupt opponent's plays using counterspells like Disrupting Shoal and Force of Negation, while also protecting your own combo pieces with Beyeen Veil and Suppression Ray, the deck aims to quickly assemble its win condition. The inclusion of Tameshi, Reality Architect and Sea Gate Restoration provide additional ways to manipulate the game in your favor, making the deck both versatile and powerful in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on quickly cycling through cards in order to fill up the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. This combo can overwhelm opponents and swing the game in your favor in a single turn. The deck includes cards like Street Wraith and Violent Outburst to cycle through the deck efficiently and set up the combo. The key strategy is to disrupt opponents while building towards the Living End combo for a powerful finish.

The deck focuses on generating and maximizing the use of +1/+1 counters through various cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Basking Broodscale. It also utilizes powerful combo pieces like Emrakul, the Promised End and Glaring Fleshraker to dominate the battlefield. The deck includes disruptive elements like Pithing Needle and Malevolent Rumble to control the opponent's strategy. With a mix of ramp cards and utility lands like Urza's Saga, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and synergies.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through cards like Ephemerate and Relic of Progenitus. With a mix of counter spells, removal, and versatile creatures, the deck seeks to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a long game. It also utilizes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana fixing and card advantage. Ultimately, the goal is to grind out the opponent and establish dominance through card advantage and powerful threats.
